candidate_oracle_separation: Candidate receives exact Lease source and public fixture; it does not receive auditor source or expected verdict rows.
auditor_separation: Auditor receives public fixture and raw candidate output, not candidate source or imported Lease implementation.
limits: network none; read-only root and source/input mounts; separate writable output; 1 CPU, 256 MiB, 64 PIDs, all capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges
scope: Synthetic finite clock/owner traces only. No actual machine sleep, GUI, physical input, model, task effect, or production behavior claim.
